product.title: POLYGON - Prototype Pack
product.body_html:
Synty® Studios presents:  POLYGON - Prototype Pack

Introducing the POLYGON - Prototype Pack, your ultimate tool for rapid game development. Designed by Synty™ Studios, this versatile asset pack empowers you to create a wide variety of games quickly and effortlessly.

With a diverse range of assets including characters, buildings, props, and environments, the POLYGON - Prototype Pack provides all the essentials you need to kickstart your game projects. Whether you're crafting a platformer, a shooter, an RPG, or something entirely unique, the modular nature of these assets allows for endless combinations and possibilities.

Experience the ease and speed of game development with the POLYGON - Prototype Pack. With pre-made assets at your fingertips, you can focus on bringing your creative vision to life without getting bogged down in lengthy asset creation processes. Whether you're a seasoned developer or a newcomer to game design, this pack streamlines the development process, enabling you to prototype and iterate on your game ideas with ease.

Unlock the potential of rapid game development and bring your ideas to life in record time with the POLYGON - Prototype Pack. Dive into a world of endless creativity and watch your game concepts come to life before your eyes.

The ultimate collection for crafting prototypes, grey boxing demo scenes, and more. It includes diagnostic assets for teams to communicate design decisions using notes, markers and more. It's easy to try out ideas using the POLYGON style speed build blocks and primitives.

 ◼ Key Features◼

  • 444 unique assets
  • 10 alternative texture colors
  • Polygon and Simple Versions of building assets
  • Demo Scene included

 *Contents may vary between engines.  

📦 Pack Content

Demo Scene
- Included in Unity and Unreal project files

◼ Props ◼
Walls, Ramps, Stairs, Doors, Windows, Floors, Ladders, Roofs, Curved walls, Rails, Columns, Terrains, Pipe set, Road cones, Road barrier, Wood Planks, Metal plate with bolts, Chest, Crate, Question mark crate, Barrel, Vase\Urn, Tree, Bomb, Cube tree, Polygon blob tree, Tropical tree, Pine tree, Bush, Rocks, Pebbles, Boost pad, Bat, Knife, Sword, Shield, Rifle, Pistol, Stopwatch, Shooting target, Generic assets including the grasses and Clouds

◼Characters with Alternative colours◼
Dummy Female x1, Dummy Male x1, Face Female x1, Face Male x1, No Face Female x1, No Face Male x1

◼Character Pawns (Still poses)◼
Cover Female, Cover Male, Cower Female, Cower Male, Dead Female, Dead Male, Hands Up Female, Hands Up Male, Idle Female, Idle Male, Ladder Climb Female, Ladder Climb Male, Run Female, Run Male, Walk Female, Walk Male, Weapon Female 01, Weapon Male 01, Weapon Female 02, Weapon Male 02

◼Vehicle◼
Sports car x1

◼Icons◼
Alphabet and Numbers - A-Z, 0-9, #, !, $, ?, Player icon, Weapon/Gun/Axe, Home, Ammo, Health, 3D Camera, Lights, Arrows, Spawns, Skull, Start, Finish, Weather icons, Save, Star, Coin, Gem, Apple, Banana, Candy, Balloon, Vehicle, Error, Cross, Tick, Cog, Padlock open/closed, Key, Pencil, Red circle, Drawing Pin, Game notes, Folder, Spanner, Speech bubble, Boost, Potion Vile, Power button symbol, Retro game controller, Ground rings for pawns

◼Primitives (high poly and low poly)◼
Sphere, Cube, Oblong, Torus, Cone, Wedge, Cylinder and quarter wedge, Half pipe, Curved ramp, Pyramid

◼FX◼
- Glowy ring with fade x2, Explosion x1, Fire x1, Smoke x1
Character setup to work with Mecanim (no animations included in this pack)

🤖 Technical Info

◼ Compatibility ◼

  • Compatible with Unreal 5.3+
  • Compatible with Unity 2022.3+
    - Supports URP and Built-in
    - Characters set up with Mecanim (no animations included)

◼ File Formats ◼

  • Unreal 5.3 project
  • Unity 2022.3 package
  • FBX Source Files
